findings.text: Biggest gain: Start to T1, +0.21 s for VER L16 over RUS L16. Reaches 9 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #2: T1, +0.16 s for VER L16 over RUS L16. Brakes 27 m earlier, carries 4 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #3: T4, +0.09 s for RUS L16 over VER L16. Carries 5 km/h more minimum speed, exits 5 km/h faster.
Gain #4: T10, +0.09 s for VER L16 over RUS L16. No clear difference in the recorded channels.
Gain #5: T8, +0.08 s for RUS L16 over VER L16. Exits 5 km/h slower.
